title: CISSP Domains (CBK)
description: The eight domains defined by ISC² that make up the CISSP Common Body of Knowledge.

title: Domain 1 - Security and Risk Management
description: Covers foundational security concepts, risk management, governance, compliance, and ethics.

title: Domain 2 - Asset Security
description: Covers the classification, ownership, and protection of information and physical assets.

title: Domain 3 - Security Architecture and Engineering
description: Covers secure design principles, security models, cryptography, and physical security.

title: Domain 4 - Communication and Network Security
description: Covers secure network architecture, transmission methods, and communication protocols.

title: Domain 5 - Identity and Access Management
description: Covers identification, authentication, authorization, and access control mechanisms.

title: Domain 6 - Security Assessment and Testing
description: Covers security assessments, penetration testing, audits, and logging and monitoring.

title: Domain 7 - Security Operations
description: Covers incident response, investigations, disaster recovery, and operational security.

title: Domain 8 - Software Development Security
description: Covers secure coding practices, software development lifecycle security, and application security.

title: Security and Risk Management Frameworks
description: Structured models and standards used to guide security and risk management practices.

title: Framework Types
description: The different categories or classifications of security and risk management frameworks.

title: NIST
synonyms: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: US federal agency that publishes widely adopted cybersecurity and risk management frameworks.

title: ISO/IEC
description: International standards body publishing security management standards such as the ISO/IEC 27000 series.
